name: SIFTキーポイントフォレンジクス
description: 使用します Scale-Invariant Feature Transform keypoints を検出するために duplicated and manipulated image regions.
algorithm: SIFT-Based Copy-Move Forgery Detection with Geometric Verification
mechanism: 抽出します SIFT keypoints and descriptors from the image, then matches them to find duplicated regions. Geometric verification using RANSAC eliminates false matches.
parameters: Octaves: 4, Scales: 5, Descriptor: 128-dim, Matching: ratio test (0.6), Verification: RANSAC
source: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Robust コピームーブ偽造 検出 invariant to scaling, rotation, and 照明 changes

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• スケールと回転に不変
• 幾何学的検証により誤マッチを削減
• コンピュータビジョンで実証済み
• 部分的なオクルージョンに対応
limitations:
• 計算コストが高い
• Struggles with smooth/textureless regions
• Memory intensive for many keypoints
• Parameter 感度
